paras: Try it in the Inner Signal app

You will need to download Inner Signal App for voice hypnosis, information, to learn the language, and for feedback on what you report. Have fun. Feel free to ask any questions you might have about what the hypnotist is doing. Self hypnosis is a great tool, but you don't need an app to do it. You may want to find someone, but it is not required to graduate.

If you’re using the ChatGPT version of this app, you might want to upload a picture, drawing, poem or song to talk about instead of writing out your explanation in prose. But please make sure the file you upload can be seen or heard by the chat you’re currently using! It will probably tell you that it can’t see or hear the file if you’ve made this mistake. Please remember that what’s in the file, what it means to you, and what the app thinks it means, are three different things, and that you get to decide for yourself whether the app has interpreted it correctly – you don’t have to defend your choice of medium.

fixes.replace: what you say about what’s in the file

paras: Bear in mind that even with voice, the app is asking you what’s going on for you – it can’t feel your body, share a practitioner’s embodied intuition, or know a response you don’t report. The app is not pretending to be a skilled therapist, just helping you to learn for yourself, so that you can make better-informed choices.
